title: Browser tag firing does not prove analytics ingestion or conversion
project_brief: A lead-generation website uses analytics and conversion measurement.
request: The analytics tag fires in browser debug mode, but provider ingestion and conversion configuration have not been observed. Assess what remains required before claiming conversion tracking and attribution are verified.

must_recognize: tag implementation is distinct from transport/provider ingestion
conversion configuration and attribution require separate evidence
must_not_claim: valid conversion or attribution merely because browser debug shows the tag firing
